messages:
Maya S: Customer hit intermittent 400 on embeddings/rerank endpoint. Error text: \"batch payload dimension mismatch\". Customer reports ~0.5% of requests fail, random. Example request id: req_2035_8f7b2a. Timestamp: 2035-12-03T12:10:22Z. Can we collect repro steps and a debug bundle?

Alex R: thanks, Maya. can you paste the exact request body (redact PII) and the full response headers? that helps rule out client-side chunking or gzip issues.

Maya S: here’s a minimal customer curl they ran (redacted):
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank \\n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_***\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  --data-binary '{"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"find best foo"}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","embedding":[0.1,0.2,...(1024 floats)...]}, {"id":"c2","embedding":[0.1,0.2,...(512 floats)...]}]}'
```

Maya S: customer says they batch variable-length candidate embedding arrays into a single request and occasionally one candidate has a different dim (maybe due to a preprocessing bug). response body was 400 with {"error":"payload: vector length mismatch"} and header x-request-id: req_2035_8f7b2a.

Samir: copying repro checklist: 1) grab request id and trace from gateway: `grep req_2035_8f7b2a /var/log/redwood/gateway.log` 2) pull model server logs for the same window 3) check client gzip/transfer-encoding 4) get raw request body.

Samir: example gateway grep (internal):
```bash
sudo journalctl -u redwood-gateway --since \"2035-12-03 12:09\" --until \"2035-12-03 12:12\" | grep req_2035_8f7b2a -A4 -B4
```

Alex R: also verify the client used `--data-binary` and not `-d` with `--compressed` or a lib that auto-gzips. We had a past bug where Content-Encoding header mismatch led to truncated arrays. If possible, ask customer to run this reproducer (quick python):
```python
import requests, json
url='https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank'
body={
  "queries": [{"id":"q1","text":"foo"}],
  "candidates": []
}
# append one correct-length vector then one truncated
vec_full=[0.01]*1024
vec_short=[0.01]*512
body['candidates'].append({"id":"c1","embedding":vec_full})
body['candidates'].append({"id":"c2","embedding":vec_short})
print(json.dumps(body)[:200])
r = requests.post(url, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer REDACT","Content-Type":"application/json"}, json=body)
print(r.status_code, r.text)
```

Julia: I created a support ticket and an upload folder for debug bundles. Maya, can you ask the customer to upload the debug bundle (curl -v, full response headers, raw request body if possible) to: https://support.redwood.ai/bundles/2035-embed-repro-8f7b2a and put the URL here. Also we need the SDK version and whether they use our JS or Python SDK.

Maya S: customer uploaded bundle: https://support.redwood.ai/bundles/2035-embed-repro-8f7b2a (contains raw_request.json, response_headers.txt, gateway_trace.log). They are on node-sdk v1.2.0.

Samir: pulled gateway_trace.log. snippet: 
```
[2035-12-03T12:10:22Z] req=req_2035_8f7b2a method=POST path=/v1/embeddings/rerank client=54.23.12.9 content-length=123456 content-encoding=identity status=400 \"payload: vector length mismatch\"
[2035-12-03T12:10:22Z] req=req_2035_8f7b2a body_checksum=7a9f... routed_to=model-pool-5
```

Samir: model server logs for model-pool-5 show: 
```
ERROR 2035-12-03T12:10:22Z handler=rerank request=req_2035_8f7b2a \
  validate_vectors failed: expected_dim=1024 got=512 candidate_index=1
  stack: ValidateVectorsError at src/validate.cc:87
```

Alex R: that looks like the client actually sent mixed dims. two action items: 1) ask customer to run the python reproducer above and post results 2) if reproducible, ask for a minimal curl that reproduces the failure (raw bytes). We should also add a guard in gateway to reject mixed-dim batches with clearer error message containing expected_dim.

Julia: tagging eng-runtime on-call for a quick code patch decision: @eng-runtime oncall — any objection to returning 422 with a payload that lists offending indices and expected dim? current 400 is ambiguous for customers.

SupportBot: Ticket #SUP-2035-887 created and linked to bundle. SLA: 48h for P1 initial response.

Maya S: customer ran python repro and confirms they can reproduce locally. output: `400 {"error":"payload: vector length mismatch (expected 1024, got 512)"}`. They attached minimal_repro.json and a network capture.

Samir: good. please upload minimal_repro.json to the bundle and paste the minimal curl here. I'll run it through the staging gateway and attach logs.

Maya S: minimal curl (raw):
```bash
curl -v -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/rerank \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACT\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  --data-binary @minimal_repro.json
```

Alex R: ran on staging: got identical 400 and model log shows candidate_index=1 mismatch. I patched a small middleware on staging to include expected_dim in response body for clarity. New response: `422 {"error":"vector length mismatch", "expected_dim":1024, "index":1}`.

Julia: thanks. next steps for support: 1) advise customer to validate embedding extractor to always emit 1024-d vectors and add a client-side preflight check (we can share a snippet) 2) propose temporary mitigation: reject mixed-dim batches client-side with clear error message 3) eng to consider server-side validation improvements.

Alex R: sample client preflight (pseudocode):
```js
const dims = new Set(candidates.map(c => c.embedding.length))
if (dims.size > 1) throw new Error('mixed embedding dims in batch: ' + Array.from(dims))
```

Maya S: I notified customer of the mitigation and the staged 422 behavior. They want an ETA for a fix to make errors clearer in prod. Julia, can you track SLA and get eng timeline?

Julia: added to ticket SUP-2035-887, assigned eng-runtime for triage, requested ETA. I'll update channel when we have a plan.

Samir: notes for postmortem: root cause likely client-side preprocessing bug that sometimes strips half of the vector (e.g., JSON stringify bug or streaming buffer cut). Recommend adding a gateway-level sanity check: sample first candidate length and ensure all others match before forwarding to model pool.

Maya S: great — thanks everyone. closing loop once eng gives ETA. :thumbsup:
